_rule: Candidate instruments: every reading we could build on the methylation channel, each with the term of the law it reads, its substrate, its blind spot, its advantage, what would break it, and the next concrete step. The point is NOT to pick one - several instruments with different blind spots, agreeing on the same sample, is worth more than one instrument we trust. Priority is by (decides something) x (free or cheap) / (blocked). Written 2026-10-13 from the session that produced these ideas. Nothing here is sealed; an entry becomes a sealed test only through its own door note.
title: Candidate instruments, by priority

instruments.name: Clustering meter (C-score): finish its commissioning
instruments.reads: whether losses are CLUSTERED (whole stretches) rather than scattered - the shape of the loss, not its size
instruments.substrate: arrays (EPIC v1 now; 450K and EPIC v2 later)
instruments.cost: free (a metadata search, then one laptop read)
instruments.status: test (a) MET in two laboratories that had no part in setting the band (34/35 and 22/23 healthy, 95 % bar)
instruments.open: new SAME-PERSON replicate arrays, from a set that did not help build the band, to confirm the repeatability bar
instruments.advantage: clustering is the cancer fingerprint; ordinary aging and inflammation scatter errors instead. Most specific thing we have
instruments.blind: whole blood so far, while the meter it rides on is commissioned on sorted cells - that scope gap must be reconciled before any detection claim; and one array decided the second test (22/23 = 95.65 % against 95 %)
instruments.breaks: healthy replicate pairs from one person differing by more than the band's own tolerance
instruments.next: search GEO for healthy EPIC v1 series with same-person repeats, excluding every set in the spent register

instruments.name: Territory contrast: fidelity in fragile territory over fidelity in stable territory
instruments.reads: WHERE the loss happens first - a sustained energy shortfall should take the late-replicating, solo-WCGW territory before it touches housekeeping promoters
instruments.cost: free (design, synthetic test, then existing arrays)
instruments.open: everything: derivation of the expected ordering, site classes fixed before any read, synthetic test, then real arrays
instruments.advantage: SELF-TARING - a ratio inside one array, so plate, batch and much of the composition effect cancel because numerator and denominator see the same cell mixture. Attacks the exact spread problem that blocked the blood answer tonight
instruments.blind: says nothing about absolute fidelity; a loss that is uniform across territories is invisible to it
instruments.breaks: the ordering reversing - stable territory losing before fragile territory in a condition known to cost the cell energy
instruments.next: write the design with its falsifier and the site-class rule BEFORE touching an array

instruments.name: Met-A on whole blood: measure the real healthy spread
instruments.reads: total disorder above what the estimated cell mixture explains - the existing composition-aware reading, in a tube of blood
instruments.cost: free (one laptop read of arrays already on disk)
instruments.status: leverage measured on synthetic blood: a 1 % neutrophil drop moves the reading +2.64 % at a 0.40 share, +3.79 % at 0.55, +5.13 % at 0.70
instruments.open: the detection limit - the spread between REAL healthy people, which the simulation cannot supply
instruments.advantage: dilution costs much less than expected, and the function already exists in the chain
instruments.blind: an array averages molecules before anyone reads them, so one cell type can never be isolated - only the one-directional question is available. And the healthy whole bloods in hand are spent as the clustering meter's test, so this is development use
instruments.breaks: healthy people differing by more than the leverage of the signal we are looking for (then arrays cannot carry blood and sequencing is required)
instruments.next: run the chain's whole-blood function on the real healthy arrays already calibrated on disk and report the spread

instruments.name: Distance to the ceiling
instruments.reads: how close a sample sits to the derived entropy ceiling - the right-hand mark of the gauge, past which the reading stops rising with further loss
instruments.cost: free (arithmetic on readings we already have)
instruments.status: the ceiling is in the foundation as derived. AUDIT DONE 2026-10-13 (DEV-CEILING-AUDIT-01): of 7,681 readings that record the flag, none is past the ceiling; the composition-aware path never recorded it, so the three sealed tissue results cannot be audited from saved files, and that gap could only have cost detections
instruments.open: re-read the three sealed tissue sets with the flag recorded (free, arrays on disk, reported as an audit that cannot change their sealed verdicts); and the reading itself - distance to the ceiling has still never been reported as a number
instruments.advantage: derived with no free parameter, and it answers the author's own question - how far from the ceiling a tumor arrives
instruments.blind: only informative for samples near the ceiling; says nothing about a healthy-range sample
instruments.breaks: a sample reading past the ceiling, which the derivation forbids
instruments.next: compute it for every sealed cancer reading already in the records and check none is past the turnover

instruments.name: Run-length spectrum of losses
instruments.reads: the SHAPE of clustering - exponential against heavy-tailed, which separates a processive mechanism from independent point losses
instruments.substrate: sequencing only (needs several sites on one molecule)
instruments.cost: laptop work on reads already in storage; no new sequencing
instruments.open: the derivation of the expected shape under each mechanism, then a synthetic test
instruments.advantage: same data as the clustering meter, different question; distinguishes mechanism rather than only size
instruments.blind: impossible on arrays; needs depth, so shallow libraries are out
instruments.breaks: the measured shape matching neither mechanism's prediction in a case where the mechanism is known
instruments.next: after the sequencing instrument is released from hold

instruments.name: Tail of fragments in plasma (the early-detection instrument)
instruments.reads: the few badly disordered MOLECULES in a plasma sample, not the average - because early cancer is a tiny minority of fragments and an average hides it by construction
instruments.cost: box time per sample; the expensive one
instruments.open: the sequencing instrument is held, the atlas is not commissioned, and a healthy plasma reference does not exist yet
instruments.advantage: the highest reward on the whole board - it is the blood test, and a tail statistic is the right shape for early detection
instruments.blind: needs depth and fragment length; a shallow or heavily fragmented sample has no tail to read. Composition of plasma is itself a question
instruments.breaks: the tail in healthy plasma being as heavy as in known cancer plasma
instruments.next: blocked behind the sequencing instrument's trim rule and the atlas; do not spend box money on it yet

gate.name: Not an instrument, but it releases two of them: the trim rule
gate.text: The sequencing instrument is held because the same kit read differently in two laboratories, and the cause is largely where in each file we read. Reading more places failed its planted test (pooling dilutes a bias, it cannot remove one). The remedy is to exclude the unsettled head of each run, decided by the sequencer's own per-cycle quality rather than by whether our answer improves. Instruments 5 and 6 are both behind it.

closing: Several instruments, each with a different blind spot, reading the same sample and agreeing - that is worth far more than one instrument we trust. Disagreement is also informative: a sample that reads normal on total disorder and abnormal on clustering is telling us which channel failed.
